notes: Forty-five source and fifty-three target tokens each partitioned once; forty-four units, since בְּתוֹךְ fuses.
בְּתוֹךְ → among is one English word and the morphemes are contiguous, so rule 30 fuses them here; contrast EZK.6.7, where the ASV writes in the midst of and rule 2 splits the same pair.
In the tops of the mountains the ASV writes two the's, so nothing is fronted: the present article takes the one standing before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).
רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ → sweet savor is the construct rendered attributively under rule 28; אֲשֶׁר takes where and its resumptive שָׁם is unrepresented under rule 22.
The margin's 'terebinth' for אֵלָה is not the text aligned.
